doc.title: Holman Bill — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Benny Carter in Los Angeles
summary: Carter was on another level, did some television writing in the 1950s and had a couple of successful records.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Returning to some of the arrangers, I was looking at some of the other dates that had you listed as arranger. Benny Carter was listed also as an arranger. He was out here by about that time, I presume. Did he make it out here by the ‟50s? I don‟t think Oliver Nelson was out here yet.
I think he was here earlier than that.
Yes, that‟s true, in the ‟40s, because I know . . .

Yeah, he made a couple of records that did pretty well. One of them was called Malibu, I think. Benny was also in another level, one of jazz history‟s greats. He didn‟t mess around with us too much. He did a little bit of t.v. writing during the ‟50s, but I don‟t think he was doing any jazz work. I don‟t know what – he must have been playing somewhere, but I don‟t know where. Maybe he traveled.
